description: Store binary content with metadata in blob storage. Returns unique blob_id for later retrieval. Registered dispatch returns a queued job_id/status receipt. Read job_service.get_job by that exact id for the full original result or typed error; do not repeat uncertain effects after input or worker loss. Direct Python calls retain synchronous results. Owner admission persists a bounded descriptor. Before admission, the existing poller transport preflight parses, schema-validates and reserializes input under the 16 MiB payload guard. This known bounded residual is outside this Unit acceptance under the coordinator ruling agm-_699f6a6e354543f4bd4ef9f3336ac3cf and transport evidence uev_022644ad06f143488311abc4401cadbf. The Blob review measured 81.65 ms for an offline 16 MiB-content preflight probe before admission (uev_8d5cbc6a87c6497d8a0c96de56b5761d), not live latency or persisted-job timing. The under-50-ms receipt acceptance covers ordinary arguments through real preflight while the Blob leaf is parked.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Storage confirmation with blob_id (unique identifier for retrieval), size (bytes stored), namespace, and any user-provided metadata
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Stores binary content (files, images, audio, etc.) in blob storage with metadata
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: content or namespace invalid. StorageError: blob storage service unavailable or quota exceeded. NamespaceError: namespace does not exist or access denied.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For validation errors: check content encoding and namespace format. For storage errors: retry or check service status. For quota errors: consider deleting old blobs or contact admin.
